## Description

Review and accept ADR-012 (Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server per country, EF Core on Npgsql, row-level security with `current_setting`, envelope encryption of national IDs with Key Vault keys and an HMAC blind index, hash-chained audit and signed records, masked views). Mark the SQL Server statements in ADR-001, 005 and 006 as superseded.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given ADR-012, when it is reviewed, then it is Accepted with date and decider and lists the alternatives rejected (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, an ORM change).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given ADR-001, ADR-005 and ADR-006, when they are read, then each points to ADR-012 for what changed.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
